# has pose position

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:hasPosePosition`](gmeow-hasPosePosition.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasPosePosition>

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for the translational component of a pose, as [`SpatialCoordinates`](../classes/gmeow-SpatialCoordinates.md) in the pose frame; a part of the pose.

### Avoid when

- Avoid for the rotational component ([`gmeow:hasPoseOrientation`](gmeow-hasPoseOrientation.md)).

### How to use

- Point [`gmeow:hasPosePosition`](gmeow-hasPosePosition.md) at [`SpatialCoordinates`](../classes/gmeow-SpatialCoordinates.md) expressed in the [`gmeow:poseFrame`](gmeow-poseFrame.md).
